author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. We're looking for artists that draws: Anime / manga style illustrations; Cartoon / semi-cartoon illustration; Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork; Semi-realistic illustrations; and any other art styles. Comment if you're interested or DM me directly! Follow-up (2026-09-21): still reviewing portfolios and asking people who have not sent a portfolio link to send one.

author: Bee (Shel)
title: Paid character/concept art for fantasy series
content: ARTISTS + ANIMATORS OF THREADS! I'm a writer developing an adult fantasy animated series and I'm looking for artists to help bring it to life! I'm starting small, but this is paid work. I'm looking to commission character/concept art first and grow from there. Fantasy artists/animators—drop your work + rates!! Contact: reply on the Threads post with work and rates. Follow-up (2026-09-13): author said they were overwhelmed by responses and still figuring out funding and budgeting, but did not close the request.

author: Tee Yuan Xin
title: Freelance graphic designer for campaign visuals
content: Looking for a Freelance Graphic Designer. Currently looking for someone who can support us on upcoming client projects, mainly for: social media visuals; ads creatives; campaign posters; simple visual adaptations / resizing. Prefer someone who has a good eye for clean and modern design, can follow brand guidelines / references well, is responsive and able to meet deadlines, and is comfortable handling ad and social media creatives. Contact: reply or DM on Threads (@yuanxin_289).
